title: RAW whole f31r second paragraph: later disclosure of one seed rite and time-indexed knowledge
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED. Retain all complete original seed-rite candidates and their exact values per candidate. A later explanation or discovery must bind the same recipient, knowledge object and explicit time while the same seeds remain in the cloth. Knowing how to attach the cloth versus knowing its purpose remains a real rival; another truth-table sweep cannot decide it.
phase: bounded exploratory proposal; no target test or new meaning confirmed
access: Existing primary meaning contracts and metadata only for newly nominated adjoining units. No raw target census, new image, reserve, source download, contact, semantic execution or code. All hypotheses are previously exposed or newly proposed exploration, not holdout confirmation.
claim_ceiling: A successful complete draft could supply a constrained working reading and a written consequence; it would not prove any word, source identity or historical meaning. No experiment may start before a full exact draft and separate review.

target.selection_reason: Immediate whole successor of fixed37-group .1–5; both readers have27 groups with matching full boundaries. No target lexical census or source search used.
target.missing_reader_rule: An empty RF1b array is NO_WHOLE_READER in this cache. It is not permission to fabricate paragraph boundaries or import another edition’s groups. If a complete owned corresponding line union is later found, retain its native boundary status separately.

fixed_inputs.values: All30 original entries within each frozen candidate remain fixed. The different-object candidates share29 literal values with the main candidate: their chey reference-macro value and one implicit object binding already differ, as GDT1027 explicitly records. Preserve those differences, never claim one shared30-value lexicon across all8.
fixed_inputs.roles: A actor, W recipient, same G seed group, R raisins, C cloth, binding time t_bind. YOU always A; RECIPIENT always W within the same case. Actor purity is distinct from knowledge; the same-object distinct-person inference remains conditional.
fixed_inputs.scope: All8 quantity×knowledge×purity candidates retained; four recipient-purity candidates remain coherent but omit the historical actor-purity condition. The original physical trace remains unchanged and the release promise remains attributed.

design.whole_content_offer: The complete next paragraph is an explanation or disclosure concerning the just bound seed rite: what its actor knows, what the recipient is subsequently told or discovers, and which procedure or purpose is the object of that knowledge. The cloth and seed group provide the persistent case reference; a later knowledge statement must not retrospectively change ignorance at t_bind. This is a proposed commentary hypothesis, not a supplied lost sentence of Cyranides.
new_written_obligation: Every later KNOWS occurrence must take a particular written or fixed anaphoric proposition and time. Repeated chey retains the candidate’s frozen full proposition; it cannot be reduced to the attachment procedure in one place and the purpose in another.

If the complete continuation asserts recipient knowledge of the previously denied proposition, it needs a later-time binding or a distinct explicit reported/conditional scope. No automatic learning, forgetting, knowledge from purity, or knowledge of the purpose from merely wearing the cloth.

If a new instruction uses THE SEEDS or the same cloth again, it must start from the old contained-and-bound G/C state. Naming G creates no loose replacement. Any new physical handling must be explicit and separate from learning or an attributed relief claim.

A written identification of the original actor with recipient still conflicts with the old same-object/same-time facts; a later role change does not make that earlier identity true. Under the different-object variant it may be coherent. This can matter only if the entire continuation actually asserts identity; it is not presumed as a desired outcome.
design.capacity_gate: The fixed whole unit must contain exact qokeey=KNOWS and at least one exact old person/proposition term {daiin,[s:r]air,chey}. If not, close this proposed knowledge continuation without new synonyms or a new paragraph search. Material references alone are insufficient for its distinct purpose.

rivals.meaning: A later explicitly scoped information event changes what W knows about this fixed rite.
The full paragraph restates the original knowledge constraints, with no information event or later knowledge acquired.
Preserve the already frozen P_attach/P_purpose candidate. The same full continuation must be checked against that candidate’s distinct old chey value, without mixed references.
A genuinely new case has explicitly introduced participants/materials/proposition. It is not a free repair for old YOU, THE SEEDS or THIS_RITE references.

strongest_countercases: GDT1027 already proves scope-conditioned identity consequences. Repeating Boolean worlds or counting more purity assignments would add no research decision.
The source supplies recipient ignorance but not the positive actor knowledge or one full shared knowledge object. No source paraphrase can independently force those target bindings.
Old IT35 has9 unknown exact forms; ZL retains three uncertain groups. Do not quietly import GDT1038 amulet packing: it belongs to a different lexicon and this card allows no split repair.

No epistemic inertia law or requirement that learning must be mentioned is inherited. The continuation must itself supply its positive knowledge/time claim; mere absence of a learning word is not a hard contradiction.
design.smallest_next_retrieval: Freeze the entire nominated unit before opening its word body. Retain every position and every already-owned alternate reading. After selection, first report exact inherited matches and all unknown forms, then attempt the complete paragraph within the declared caps. A failed coverage/cost gate closes this nomination; no fallback paragraph, source normalization, new aliases or cap increase. Preserve the best full incomplete draft with its exact remaining obligations.
design.outcomes: Retain a full continuation only if its written repeated knowledge/referent clauses constrain one actual candidate distinction. Otherwise MISSING_BINDING or NO_CAPACITY for this nomination, not a new confirmation of the old world enumeration.
